pages.title: Distortion Fluid
pages.text: Before any other core, I needed distortion I could touch. Under dripstone, water drinks it in and thickens into $(thing)distortion fluid$(). Shards are soaked in it, and the $(l:machines/reconstruction)Reconstruction Chamber$() drinks it.
A conduit's heart, taught to pull instead of push. The water around it never quite stops moving.

pages.name: Distortion Condensator
pages.text: Cauldrons under dripstone ring the conduit core.

pages.title: The Basin
pages.text: Cobblestone and walls, a back wall of copper grates, glass sides, water cauldrons with pointed dripstone hanging over them, and the conduit core over a cauldron basin.

pages.title: Its Thirst
pages.text: A thousand measures of water and 200 DE, five seconds, and half of it comes back as fluid. Both of its tanks hold eight thousand.$(br2)The basin shows the water it holds, the ring the fluid it made.

pages.title: Its Habits
pages.text: I pour water in by bucket or pipe on any of its stones, and draw the fluid out the same way.$(br2)Like every core, it starves without a $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$() above it.
